newDesignGap.description: EV startup lacks decorative REGEN←0→POWER signed scan; all production coordinator override fractions are nonnegative and depend only on era, while representative EV instruments show drive input or power readouts. Verified absence is a visual startup design gap, not fabricated regeneration telemetry or SOC support.

limitations: Synthetic continuous Store data, no real FH6 UDP samples. Parallel headless workload is not performance acceptance.
Captured DOM property positions/transforms and digital text, not a blanket visual or factory-reference acceptance.
Mechanical spring lag is intentional smoothing and was not counted as a new fault.
Initial combustion cases deliberately omit throttle/temperature/G values; EV validity checks separately supply throttle190/255.
Five stale cases inject stale in the render context while underlying packets continue, verifying projection boundary only; they are not actual physical disconnection tests.
Early911 digital values are div elements omitted by the initial leaf collector; its actual needle transforms were captured and physical speed/rpm can be recovered from them.
No production JavaScript/CSS modified; helper scripts and one JSON artifact only.

evidenceRetention: Raw repeated DOM attributes were reduced to representative scan/return/live snapshots. First/last scan, first/middle/last return, and first/100/300/600/last live samples are retained where observed. Static SVG path definitions dropped except dynamic classical needles; original sample counts retained.
